## RE:volution Mod v1.2.2

### Added
- Added persistent rune upgrade resources: `rune_dust`, `rune_shards`, and `rune_cores`.
- Added client/server synchronization for all three rune resource balances.
- Added Admin / Test Panel support for setting, adding, and zeroing rune resources.
- Split the player resource UI into separate currency and rune-resource sections.

### Fixed
- Removed the deprecated `lightnings` resource from the active resource model and Admin / Test Panel.
- Added cleanup for legacy lightning fields in MongoDB player data and obsolete lightning mob reward data.
- Reduced the first-open GUI pause by preloading the custom GUI fonts during client initialization.

### Other
- Existing players without the new rune-resource fields start at zero automatically.
- Rune-resource balances persist across relog and server restart.
- Updated the mod version metadata to `1.2.2`.

### Download
Use the attached `customguimod-1.2.2.jar`.

**Full Changelog:** [v1.2.1...v1.2.2](https://github.com/Theyyk/re-volution-mod/compare/v1.2.1...v1.2.2)
